patch.value: Bound concurrent checkpoint fixture contention without losing promotions

Investigate release CI checkpoint promotion lock conflict from GitHub issue #152; characterize loaded contention, preserve declared bounds and checkpoint roots, and prove any correction by behavioral revert.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Read issue #152 and SDK issue #1516 including all comments. No synced match exists, so this item owns gh:unbraind/pm-rl#152. Baseline focused real-process checkpoint fixture passed 1/1 under existing host load. The shipped bounded-contention contract explicitly permits lock_conflict; the installed SDK exposes CommitWorkspaceTransactionOptions.lockWaitMs, so this is not a missing wait API. Next: 30 instrumented repetitions under one low-priority CPU burner, then deterministic live-holder timing and a behavioral revert proof. Full multi-hour npm/Bun release gates are delegated to CI by the task instruction.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Controlled live-holder reproduction failed 1/1 with the original 30000 ms fixture wait: a healthy parent holds sdk-workspace-transaction for 35000 ms; a waiting promoter reports lock_conflict/lock_owner_alive after 30007 ms (another waiter is serialized behind the approval preflight lock). This demonstrates an insufficient positive-fixture bound, not lock corruption or lost committed writes. Testing a fixture-only 120000 ms wait, aligned with its existing 120000 ms fit signal and inside its unchanged 900000 ms outer deadline. Production lock defaults, retry contracts, trainer budgets and pinned SDK remain unchanged. The unforced instrumented baseline remains at its original 30000 ms wait until all 30 repetitions finish.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof: in a disposable source copy, change only concurrentCheckpointPromotions waitMs default from 120000 to 30000 and run Node 26.13.0: node --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-name-pattern="outwait a healthy" test/checkpoint-artifacts.test.ts. It fails 1/1 with SDK lock_conflict, lock_owner_alive, waited_ms=30006. The fixed 120000 ms implementation passed 1/1 on Node 24.19.0 and 1/1 on Node 26.13.0 before this revert; rerun the fixed test after all edits. Both promoters retain their original job identities, exactly one training charge each, both promoted roots and the single verified shared artifact. No SDK defect is established and no upstream issue should be filed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resumed PR #158 review round 1. Worktree is clean at 63cc6cd and main is already an ancestor, so no merge is needed. Both inline findings and the additional review-body timing note identify one class: a contention regression must observe a real acquisition attempt and measure its blocked interval, rather than infer contention from child readiness or an owner timer. Search all package lock-contention tests and exposed SDK/CLI/packed surfaces for the same rule; add a delayed-before-attempt adversarial case and behavioral revert evidence. Preserve the completed 60-run evidence without rerunning it. The new instruction requires full npm and Bun gates sequentially with at most two workers, and explicitly authorizes a review-response comment and new review request.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Class audit complete: reviewed all package TypeScript timer/delay and lock call sites, SDK adapters in state-boundary.ts, index.ts, checkpoint-artifacts.ts and evaluation-plan.ts; lock tests in sdk-adoption, sdk-lock-confinement, state-boundary, lineage, sequential-evaluation and evaluation-plan; process/controller heartbeat and polling barriers; acceptance/packed and compatibility consumers including JSON/TOON and no-git fixtures. Only concurrentCheckpointPromotions inferred a minimum contention wait from readiness plus a parent release timer. Other lock refusals execute real operations while an owner is explicitly held; heartbeat/polling timers assert observed state, not acquisition duration. The fix observes real failed native lock-file opens in the child, requires a monotonic blocked witness beyond 35000 ms before parent release, and checks the successful acquisition duration. Both children deliberately delay fitting by 8000 ms after go, exceeding the former five-second margin. Real SDK operations and filesystem calls are retained; this is observation, not an SDK mock. The first targeted attempt reached both successful publications but exposed an obsolete array destructure after switching filtered IPC receipts to objects; corrected it and rerunning focused tests before full gates.

value.text: Review regression proof passes in two independent disposable copies. Variant old-wait changes only PM_LOCK_WAIT_MS from 120000 to 30000: focused outwait test fails with lock_conflict. Thus the oracle catches the timing class independently of the chosen lock wait. Real implementation was never mutated; temporary copies were removed. Focused tests passed 2/2 before these mutations; rerun the unchanged fixed implementation through pinned pm now, then execute full npm and Bun release gates sequentially with two workers.
